newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 3.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 3.

text.p: Here are the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station's noon news report on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Parliament continues its consideration of draft law on returning property to pre-Soviet era owners.

- President Algirdas Brazauskas went to Gnezno, Poland, to particpate in the Holy Mass served by Pope John Paul II. Brazaukas will also meet his counterparts from Poland, Germany, Czesh republic, Ukraine and Sovenia.
- The praesidium of the inter-parliament Baltic Assembly will meet in Vilnius today to discuss the agenda of the Baltic Assembley session scheduled for November.
- The constitutional court will start consideration whether the former government had the right to issue financial aid to the bankrupt commercial banks Aurabank and Vakaru.
